messages:
nick: Quick flag 10 hosts behind interconnect xg-3 are showing 6-12ms p95 egress stretch to eu-west during a burst from tenant-508. Not full outage but customer-facing latency uptick. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/egress/xg-3

infra-bot: [Alert] interconnect-egress-surge detected on xg-3 at 08:02 UTC. Runbook: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/interconnect-egress

esha: Any correlation with dedicated-pool handoffs or cross-region routing changes? Could be fallback traffic dragging extra hops.

nick: I checked route table; no recent changes. But we do see a spike in retransmits and an increase in small-packet bursts from tenant-508's telemetry sidecar. tx_queue_len up, softirq skew on cpu0. Quick dump:
```
host-xg3-12:
  tx_queue_len: 34
  p95_rtt_ms: 9.8
  retransmits_pct: 0.8
  softirq_skew: cpu0
  top_sender: tenant-508-metrics (pid 9123)
```

robin: Two simultaneous problems could be at play: NIC-level coalesce thrash (softirq) and cross-region pathing adding a small but consistent hop cost. For multi-tenant safety: options are (A) irq-affinity spread + per-tenant policing, (B) nudge routing to keep tenant on local egress (sticky route) temporarily, (C) spin a micro-slice in eu-west pinned to local interconnect for tenant-508, (D) full dedicated slice if they need sustained isolation.

marta: Micro-slice sounds promising: smaller than a dedicated GPU slice, we prewarm a tiny set of resources (proxy + net-anchored host) in eu-west so their egress stays local and avoids cross-interconnect hops. Finance, what's the ballpark uplift vs doing a short-term routing sticky?

finance: Quick note: sticky-routing (keep flows on local egress) is near-zero infra cost but may reduce global load balancing flexibility. Micro-slice (prewarmed proxy + host pin) ~1.3x marginal cost at peak for that tenant. Dedicated GPU slice ~2.7x. Micro-slice gives L7 and egress locality isolation but not GPU isolation unless we reserve GPUs too.

esha: For an immediate low-risk attempt: 1) apply irq-affinity spread on affected hosts; 2) apply per-tenant tc policing (canary); 3) if still >6ms, flip routing sticky to prefer eu-west egress for tenant-508 for 30m; 4) if customer impact persists escalate to micro-slice.

nick: I'll run (1)+(2) now. If that doesn't stabilize in 8m we try sticky route. Also capturing tcpdumps for trace.

infra-bot: Action logged: irq-affinity-spread applied to host-xg3-12..15 (08:11 UTC).

nick: After irq spread p95 reduced to 5.6ms on hosts but one host still at 8.9ms. Applying per-tenant policing on the remaining host (tc classify by cgroup, 150mbit burst 12ms).

robin: Good. If policing fixes it, we still should consider an automation: detect cross-interconnect p95 delta and suggest sticky egress + cost appendix so support can offer micro-slice proactively.

marta: Agreed. Also add exporter jitter to tenant defaults to avoid synchronized pps spikes. Small config change in helm: `telemetry.poll_jitter: 200ms`.

finance: I'll draft a short appendix comparing sticky-route (operational risk), micro-slice, and dedicated-slice costs for INFRA-CL-1100. Note: micro-slice spin-up ~5-15m; dedicated-slice can be longer depending on capacity.

infra-bot: Per-tenant egress-policing enabled for tenant-508 on host-xg3-14 (08:21 UTC).

nick: After policing p95 on xg3 hosts normalized to ~3.2ms. tcpdumps show decreased pps spikes. Rolling watch for 20m.

esha: Filing INFRA-CL-1100: auto-attribution + sticky-route play + micro-slice cost appendix (owner: finance + network). Please attach tcpdumps and the tc commands used.

robin: One more ask: can monitoring highlight cross-interconnect delta (if same tenant has xg egress vs eu-west local egress difference >3ms) so runbook can recommend sticky vs micro-slice automatically? That would speed decisions.

marta: I'll add that probe to the ticket. Thanks folks 10keeping watch for 30m. :eyes:"
